title: Playful Young Boy Wrapped in Coat, 1965 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white home snapshot taken in July 1965 featuring a cute young boy sitting on the carpeted floor of a bedroom. He is humorously wrapped inside an oversized dark coat or sweater pulled up to his chin while smiling broadly for the camera. Next to him is a bed adorned with a textured white fringed bedspread. Printed on Kodak paper, this image highlights mid-20th-century family life and childhood innocence.
